entry.name: bitor
entry.description: Performs a bit-by-bit OR of two numbers (expressed in binary for the task). Outputs a number composed of all those bits which are 1 in either of the two numbers.

arguments.name: initial-value
arguments.description: Sets an initial value to be OR-ed with a number received in the left inlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Perform the calculation with the most recent values
messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the calculation with the numbers currently stored. If there is no argument,initially holds.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored for combination with a number received in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: Outputs a number composed of all those bits which are 1 in either of the two numbers.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: Combines the first and second numbers bit-by-bit, and outputs a number composed of all those bits which are 1 in either of the two numbers.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the incoming value without output
messages.description: In left inlet: The wordfollowed by a number will set the input to the bitwise-or operation without causing output (a successivewill output the result).
